name: memrove-chat
description: Drives memrove's chat memory from inside Claude Code: after each turn it compacts the chat log with Haiku on the session's own auth, and gives the model zoom, date and search tools.

memrove.title: memrove command
memrove.description: The command that runs memrove, split on spaces (no quoting). Example: python3 /path/to/scripts/memrove_v3.py --vault /path/vault --state /path/state

batches.title: Batches per turn
batches.description: At most this many compaction batches (one Haiku call each) after a turn.

model.title: Compactor model
model.description: The model alias for the compaction calls.

fresh.title: Fresh context per turn
fresh.description: After a turn, compact the session to the chat view plus the last exchange. Experimental; off by default.
